Moody’s upgrades Toyota outlook to positive, projects modest EBIT margin expansion
items.sum: Moody's Ratings revised its outlook on Toyota Motor Corporation (NYSE:TM) to positive from stable on Thursday while affirming the automaker's A1 long-term ratings, signaling growing confidence in the company's ability to navigate structural shifts across the global auto sector. Toyota (TSE:7203) Stock May Be Below Fair Value As Robotaxi News Builds

items.t: What Does Toyota Motor (TSE:7203) Going Driverless In Guangzhou Change?
items.sum: Toyota Motor (TSE:7203) and Pony.ai have launched fully driverless commercial robotaxi services in Guangzhou using the Gen 7 bZ4X Robotaxi. The service uses Level 4 autonomous vehicles and marks a shift from testing to commercial operations in a major Chinese city. items.t: Toyota's next frontier could be outer space
items.sum: Toyota, the Japanese industrial giant that evolved from making textile looms to building cars, is exploring another potentially transformative business opportunity: space.
